methodology.statistical_test: Paired t-test (within-subject, n=30 paired seeds). Each baseline arm (vanilla + FastDLLM + AB-Cache + LeDiFlow) and the FlowA framework arm were evaluated at the same 30 seeds (42..71), so the per-seed means can be paired. Paired t-test is the correct choice (upgrade from Wave 195 P3's unpaired Welch's t-test at n=3).
methodology.unit_of_replication: n = 30 seeds per arm (seeds {42..71}). For each arm × (NFE, metric) cell we compute per-seed mean (across 10 records/seed) and pair the 30 per-seed means across baseline and framework. df = n - 1 = 29.
methodology.post_hoc_power_formula: Cohen 1988 §2.4 paired form: power = T_sf(|delta|/SE - t_alpha, df) + T_cdf(-|delta|/SE - t_alpha, df) (two-sided t-distribution).
verdict_precedence: 3. SUPPORTED — Bonferroni-corrected p < alpha AND delta > 0 (framework wins)
4. REGRESSES — Bonferroni-corrected p < alpha AND delta < 0 (framework loses)
references: Hunter & Levine 2024 — modern power analysis for ML benchmarks
Wave 196 P2 spec — paired upgrade of Wave 195 P3 Table B
